newsitem.title: CHINA: Fairwood sells sells Mario for HK$36 mln..
newsitem.headline: Fairwood sells sells Mario for HK$36 mln..

text.p: Restaurant operator Fairwood Holdings Ltd announced on Sunday the sale of its Mario Restaurant Ltd for HK$36.88 million to another local restaurant operator Charter Hall Ltd.
Mario has incurred total losses of about HK$40.87 million for 1995 and 1996, and has been the major cause of Fairwood's unfavourable financial results, the company said in a statement.

The disposal of the Mario restaurant chain will allow Fairwood to focus its resources on its chain of fast food restaurants, its core business which has been performing "satisfactorily" in the past years, it said.
"After the disposal, Fairwood wil invest the proceeds in its fast food and institutional catering businesses to improve the overall profitability," the company said.
It plans to open eight fast food outlets in Hong Kong every year, the statement said.
